## Download and play

1. Download **Binding-of-Marcus-VERSION.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Double-click **Binding of Marcus.html**.

It runs offline in any modern browser, and you don't need to install anything.
The instructions and controls are in `PLAY.txt`.

### Other files
- **Binding-of-Marcus-VERSION.html**: the same game as one file, without the zip.
- **Binding-of-Marcus-VERSION-web.zip**: a multi-file build for uploading to a web host
  (itch.io as an HTML game, Netlify or GitHub Pages).
